title: Privacy Policy
body:
Last updated: August 2026

SAMS Enterprises ("SAMS", "we", "us", or "our") operates the SAMS online store, including the Sanmate and Wype collections. This Privacy Policy explains how we collect, use, store, and share personal information when you browse our website, place an order, or contact us.

1. Information we collect
• Identity and contact details: name, phone number, email address, and shipping address.
• Order details: products purchased, amounts, payment status, and delivery notes.
• Technical data: browser type, device information, and approximate location derived from IP address.
• Communication records: WhatsApp, email, or form messages you send to our team.

2. How we use your information
• To process, confirm, and deliver your orders.
• To send order updates and respond to support requests.
• To improve our website, catalogue, and customer experience.
• To detect fraud, secure payments, and meet legal obligations.
• To send optional marketing updates only if you opt in (you may unsubscribe at any time).

3. Payment information
Card and wallet payments are processed by our payment partner (Rapid Gateway). We do not store full card numbers on SAMS servers. Payment providers may collect billing details needed to complete the transaction under their own privacy terms.

4. Sharing of information
We may share limited data with:
• Couriers and logistics partners, to deliver your order.
• Payment processors, for checkout and refunds.
• Cloud hosting and media providers that help run the store.
• Professional advisers or authorities when required by law.
We do not sell your personal information.

5. Data retention
Order and customer records are kept for as long as needed for fulfilment, accounting, warranty support, and legal compliance, then deleted or anonymised where practical.

6. Your choices
You may request access, correction, or deletion of your personal data by emailing info.samsenterprise.pk@gmail.com. We may need to keep certain records related to completed purchases.

7. Cookies and analytics
We may use cookies and analytics tools (including Google Analytics when configured) to understand site traffic and improve performance. You can control cookies through your browser settings.

8. Contact
SAMS Enterprises
Email: info.samsenterprise.pk@gmail.com

By using our website or placing an order, you agree to this Privacy Policy.

title: Return Policy
body:
Last updated: August 2026

SAMS Enterprises wants you to be satisfied with every Sanmate and Wype purchase. Please read this Return Policy carefully before requesting a return.

1. Return window
Unused, unopened products in original packaging may be returned within 7 days of delivery, subject to the conditions below.

2. Eligible returns
• Item is unused, undamaged, and in resaleable condition.
• Original packaging, labels, and accessories are intact.
• Proof of purchase (order number) is provided.
• Product is not a custom, cleared, or special-order item unless we confirm otherwise in writing.

3. Non-returnable items
• Products that have been installed, used, cut, modified, or soiled.
• Items damaged after delivery due to misuse or improper installation.
• Free gifts, promotional bundles once opened, and clearance stock marked final sale.

4. How to request a return
Contact us at info.samsenterprise.pk@gmail.com or via WhatsApp with:
• Order number
• Product name / SKU
• Reason for return
• Photos of the item and packaging (if damaged or incorrect)
Our team will confirm whether the return is approved and share the return process.

5. Inspection and refunds
Returned items are inspected on receipt. Approved refunds are issued to the original payment method within 7–14 business days after inspection. Shipping fees are non-refundable unless the return is due to our error (wrong or defective item).

6. Damaged or wrong items
If you receive a damaged, defective, or incorrect product, notify us within 48 hours of delivery with clear photos. We will arrange a replacement, exchange, or refund as appropriate.

7. Contact
Email: info.samsenterprise.pk@gmail.com

title: Exchange Policy
body:
Last updated: August 2026

SAMS Enterprises offers exchanges on eligible Sanmate and Wype products so you can receive the correct size, finish, or model when stock allows.

1. Exchange window
Eligible unused products may be exchanged within 7 days of delivery.

2. Conditions
• Product must be unused and in original packaging.
• Exchange is subject to availability of the requested variant.
• Proof of purchase (order number) is required.
• Custom or special-order items are generally not exchangeable unless we agree in writing.

3. Price difference
• If the new item costs more, you pay the difference before dispatch.
• If the new item costs less, we refund the difference to your original payment method after the returned item is inspected.

4. How to request an exchange
Email info.samsenterprise.pk@gmail.com or message us on WhatsApp with your order number, the product you received, and the product you want instead. We will confirm availability and next steps.

5. Defective products
Defective or incorrectly shipped items may be exchanged at no extra shipping cost when the issue is reported within 48 hours of delivery with supporting photos.

6. Contact
Email: info.samsenterprise.pk@gmail.com

title: Shipping Policy
body:
Last updated: August 2026

SAMS Enterprises ships Sanmate and Wype products across Pakistan. Delivery times and charges depend on your city, order size, and courier availability.

1. Coverage
We deliver nationwide within Pakistan. Remote areas may require extra time or special courier arrangements.

2. Processing time
Orders are typically processed within 1–2 business days after payment confirmation. Orders placed on weekends or public holidays are processed on the next business day.

3. Estimated delivery
• Major cities: usually 2–5 business days after dispatch.
• Other cities / remote areas: usually 4–8 business days after dispatch.
These are estimates only and may vary due to weather, courier delays, or stock checks.

4. Shipping charges
Shipping fees (if any) are shown at checkout or confirmed by our team for oversized / heavy sanitary items. Free-shipping promotions apply only when stated on the site or campaign.

5. Order tracking
Once your order is dispatched, we share courier details and a tracking reference by WhatsApp or email where available.

6. Failed delivery
Please ensure your phone number and address are accurate. If delivery fails due to an incorrect address, unreachable phone, or repeated missed attempts, re-delivery charges may apply.

7. Inspection on delivery
Please inspect the parcel before signing. If the outer packaging is badly damaged, note it with the courier and contact us immediately with photos.

8. Contact
Email: info.samsenterprise.pk@gmail.com

title: Terms of Service
body:

Welcome to SAMS Enterprises. By accessing our website or placing an order for Sanmate or Wype products, you agree to these Terms of Service.

• Prices are shown in Pakistani Rupees (PKR) and may change without notice before an order is confirmed.
• We reserve the right to cancel and refund orders affected by obvious pricing or listing errors.

Payment is due at checkout through our supported payment methods. Orders remain pending until payment is confirmed. Unpaid orders may be cancelled automatically.

5. Shipping and risk
Delivery is handled under our Shipping Policy. Risk in the goods passes to you upon delivery to the address provided, except where damage in transit is reported promptly as described in our Return Policy.

6. Returns and exchanges
Returns and exchanges are governed by our Return Policy and Exchange Policy.

7. Intellectual property
Website content, branding, product photography, and logos remain the property of SAMS Enterprises or its licensors. You may not copy or reuse them without permission.

8. Limitation of liability
To the fullest extent permitted by law, SAMS is not liable for indirect or consequential losses arising from use of the site or purchase of products. Our total liability for any order is limited to the amount you paid for that order.

9. Website availability
We aim for continuous availability but do not guarantee uninterrupted access. We may update, suspend, or modify the site without notice.

10. Governing law
These terms are governed by the laws of Pakistan. Disputes will first be addressed amicably; failing that, courts in Pakistan shall have jurisdiction.

SAMS Enterprises
